# Gabriel Espinheira

> Senior Software Engineer based in Lisbon, Portugal. Originally from Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. 11 years of experience building scalable, aesthetic digital products.

## About

Gabriel Espinheira is a Senior Software Engineer with 11 years of professional experience (since 2014). He specializes in full-stack development with a strong focus on building digital products that are both functional and visually appealing. He holds a BSc in Computer Science and a post-graduate degree in Digital Tech Management.

He is originally from Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and currently lives in Lisbon, Portugal.

He is currently available for new opportunities and collaborations.

## Skills & Expertise

- Full-stack Software Engineering (11 years)
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite
- Backend: Node.js, PHP
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Convex
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Docker
- Design Enthusiast & Clean Code advocate
- AI-Augmented Coding & Prompt Engineering
- Early adopter of emerging technologies

## Tech Stack

React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, PHP, AWS, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Convex, Vite, Docker, Tailwind CSS

## Tools & Workflow

Zen Browser, Notion, Obsidian, Warp Terminal, Raycast, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Figma, Framer, LM Studio, Ollama
